messages:
Asha: Heads-up  VendorQ reported a spot-allocation reroute: 7 racks we reserved got re-allocated to a different production line. Earliest EU arrival now 2025-11-02 instead of 2025-10-12.
Ben: Yikes. Any chance of a targeted airbridge for 1-2 racks to keep the SI pilot live?
Lars-VendorQ: (Vendor) We can offer an airbridge for up to 2 racks from our Singapore pool. Spot allocation fee applies: $7k per rack for priority allocation + air freight. Can confirm serials and upload an amended manifest if you instruct.
Corinne: Product needs at least 1 rack in EU staging for HA smoke and license gating. If airbridge is $7k + freight (~$9k), that's steep but might be cheaper than delaying the SI.
Dmitri: Logistics note: airbridge will require AEO/T1 export docs and potentially different Incoterms if we change carrier. Need customs broker input and HS codes early.
Asha: Legal, any red flags with cross-border airlift and temporary import for testing (no sale)?
Legal: Temporary import for testing is OK with ATA carnet or temporary import bond, but we need full manifest + invoice and certificate of origin. Also confirm end-use restrictions.
Finance-Bot: Alert: Any spend > $5k requires manager approval. Estimated delta for 1 rack airbridge = $16k. Requesting spend approval from Partnerships budget.
Ben: If Finance balks, can we ask VendorQ for a trial-swap (swap one scheduled sea rack with a Singapore rack without air freight)? That might be cheaper but adds complexity to inventory mapping.
Lars-VendorQ: Swap possible if you accept serial remap and accept mixed firmware batches. We'll include firmware checksums in the manifest. No extra freight but handling fee $800.
Corinne: Firmware mismatch is risky for our AMI bake. If swap introduces v2.2 vs v2.3, we need factory flash or a rollback strategy. What's the flash turnaround?
Lars-VendorQ: Factory reflash available, ~36h per rack, $300 per rack handling. Can do combined swap+flash for $1,100 per swapped rack.
Asha: Tradeoffs: Airbridge = faster but expensive. Swap+flash = cheaper but adds 2-3 day lead. Product prefers swap+flash if it keeps pilot within 10 days.
Dmitri: For swap we still need manifest update, HS codes, and SERIAL->LICENSE mapping before we seed license tokens in the EU staging DC.
manifest-bot: PO 100998 status CHANGE_REQUESTED by Lars-VendorQ at 2025-08-05T11:05:12Z
Lars-VendorQ: Draft manifest snippet we'll upload if you choose swap:
```
PO: 100998
SKU: RACK-PRO-12GPU
Qty total: 7
Swap serials proposed: SQ-SG3001,SQ-SG3002
Reassigned sea serials: EU-EU4005..EU4009
Firmware: batch-A v2.2, batch-B v2.3
HS code: 8471.80.10
```
Ben: Action options: (A) Approve airbridge for 1 rack now (fastest), (B) Approve swap+factory reflash for 1 rack (cheaper), (C) Accept consolidated delay. Thoughts?
Corinne: Vote B for risk control and cost. If Finance approves marginal cost, go with swap+flash.
Finance-Bot: Noted. Please submit a formal spend request for the partnership co-op. Tag @Carter for quick review.
Asha: Okay  Asha will request co-op approval and confirm legal's temp import checklist. Lars, please hold manifest upload until we confirm option.
Lars-VendorQ: Will hold. I will prepare two manifests (airbridge + swap) and firmware checksums. ETA for upload 4 hours.
Dmitri: I'll prep license token seeding automation once serials are final. Corinne, ping me with the desired serials to reserve.
Ben: Also note marketing: we'll freeze the public marketplace announcement and enable a "partner-preview" flag if we can get one rack staged. 
Asha: Good. Action list in-thread: 1) Asha to request co-op spend approval. 2) Legal to list temp import docs required. 3) Lars to prepare manifests for both options. 4) Dmitri to stand by for token mapping. Keep updates here.
manifest-bot: Reminder: manifests will be available at https://vendorq.manifests/100998 (restricted access)
Ben: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after Co-op decision. :white_check_mark:
